changelog: Improve DeepSeek Harness, DSH GUI, long-document OCR, PDF/OFD/Office-to-Markdown, Baidu Cloud, SGLang, credential, and bilingual discovery.
summary: Install and configure the native Unlimited-OCR plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) from its Settings GUI, using Baidu Cloud or a local SGLang/OpenAI-compatible service. Use for long-document OCR; PDF, OFD, Office, text, and scanned-image to Markdown; tables, formulas, and reading order; or DSH provider, credential, local inference, GUI setup, verification, and troubleshooting.
